# origincloud_location_zone (Data Source)

A part of a region whose failures are independent of its other zones'. A zonal resource is in exactly one zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "origincloud_location_zone" "az1" {
  name = "zones/eu-central1-az1"
}

output "offers_pvs" {
  value = contains(data.origincloud_location_zone.az1.services, "pvs")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The zone's resource name, `zones/eu-central1-az1`. Its last segment is the zone in a zonal resource's name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/volumes/{volume}`.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) The name the console shows, such as `EU Central 1, zone 1`.
- `region` (String) The region the zone is in, `regions/{region}`.
- `services` (List of String) The services whose zonal resources the zone holds, by the name of their API, such as `pvs`: the host `{service}.origincloudapis.eu` serves them. Empty for a zone that holds none yet. A service is added here when its API is published.
